description:
You are the Customer Support Operations Manager at a SaaS company. Your company has just signed enterprise contracts and needs a dedicated support channel. Complete the following setup in FreeScout (http://localhost:8080, admin@helpdesk.local / Admin123!):

1. Create a new mailbox named 'Enterprise Support' with email enterprise@helpdesk.local
2. Create two new support agents: James Kowalski (email: james.kowalski@helpdesk.local, role: User) and Priya Sharma (email: priya.sharma@helpdesk.local, role: User)
3. Grant James Kowalski access to both the 'Technical Support' mailbox and the 'Enterprise Support' mailbox; grant Priya Sharma access to the 'Enterprise Support' mailbox only
4. Create a saved reply named 'Enterprise Acknowledgment' with the body: 'Thank you for contacting our Enterprise Support team. A dedicated support agent will be assigned to your case within 2 business hours.'
5. Apply the tag 'technical' to all conversations in the Technical Support mailbox (there are 5 conversations there)
6. Assign all 3 conversations in the Billing Support mailbox to the agent Sarah Mitchell
